MHBK is not Bierbach or Schartl personally and appointments remain debtor-specific.
SEPI is not FASEE; DRSF is not WSF; an industry fund is not automatically taxpayer expenditure.
BLUESEA commercial perimeter is not Gestora Blue Sea Partner, S.A. and neither is Portobello Capital, S.L.
Auren professional perimeter is not AUREN REESTRUCTURACIONES SLP.
Youtravel brand, YOUTRAVEL.COM LIMITED and Meeting Point Youtravel Tourism L.L.C. are not interchangeable across dates.
1-2-FLY, Ab-in-den-Urlaub and Loveholidays brands do not prove their historical operating legal persons.
EU Travel remains an unresolved alias/transcription and is not silently converted to Youtravel.
CNMC authorisation is not the signed homologation order or complete legal closing record.
A caret never transfers conduct, knowledge, contract, asset, debt, loss or liability.
